title: Whole Shield and Forked Staghorn Fern
description: One newly authored whole stylised staghorn-fern crown study. A short closed irregular root/crown mass carries two broad overlapping rounded shield-shaped basal fronds and three unequal arching flattened foliar fronds. Each green frond is one continuous thick closed lamina whose real outline divides into unequal open antler-like forks; it is not an assembly of stick antlers, repeated little pinnae or a perforated leaf. All numeric geometry is new. The exposed root mass has a small finite display sole; this detached crown display is not a claim that an epiphyte grows in soil. One complete static plant prop, zero scenes. No botanical species accuracy, growth stage/timing, plant-care instruction, habitat guarantee, wind, rig, collision, physics or simulation claim.
